rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for selfless concern and devotion to other people.

example.english: She has always cared for elderly people in the community out of altruism.
example.traditional: 佢一直用無私精神照顧社區入面嘅長者。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 zik6 jung6 mou4 si1 zing1 san4 ziu3 gu3 se5 keoi1 jap6 min6 ge3 zoeng2 ze2

rows.note: Use this more technical term when discussing altruism as a moral principle or theory.

example.english: The psychologist discussed how altruism influences people's decisions in the lecture.
example.traditional: 心理學家喺講座入面討論利他主義點樣影響人嘅決定。
example.jyutping: sam1 lei5 hok6 gaa1 hai2 gong2 zo6 jap6 min6 tou2 leon6 lei6 taa1 zyu2 ji6 dim2 joeng2 jing2 hoeng2 jan4 ge3 kyut3 ding6

rows.note: Use this for a particular helpful or charitable act that benefits someone else, rather than for the general quality.

example.english: Donating your old school uniforms to students in need was a real act of altruism.
example.traditional: 你捐晒啲舊校服畀有需要嘅學生，真係一樁善舉。
example.jyutping: nei5 gyun1 saai3 di1 gau6 haau6 fuk6 bei2 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 hok6 saang1 zan1 hai6 jat1 zong1 sin6 geoi2
